serverInfo.name: livedatalink
serverInfo.description: LiveDataLink - Public data for AI agents. 381 tools across 82 domains, with freshness varying by source: finance (stocks, options, company data), crypto, transportation (FMCSA carrier safety), property records, weather & air quality, vehicle VIN/recalls, package tracking, local business search, sanctions screening, FEMA disasters, federal courts, cyber vulnerabilities, US college metrics, EIA energy data, FRED Federal Reserve economic data, SEC EDGAR filings, NREL renewable energy, US Census demographics, EPA environmental compliance, FEC campaign finance, USPTO patents, IRS nonprofits, US caselaw, public-domain books (full-text search), open-access scholarly papers, federal regulations (Federal Register + CFR), and real-estate market data (Zillow home values + rents by metro/state), and property parcel records (assessed value + sale history, Maryland statewide), federal spending and contracts (USAspending), and clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov). One endpoint, one API key, and subscription plans with included monthly queries. Focused workflow pilots: freight carrier review at https://livedatalink.ai/pilot/freight, fintech diligence at https://livedatalink.ai/pilot/fintech, and real-estate market review at https://livedatalink.ai/pilot/real-estate.
